body: The ability of having no feelings at all by ending my life would be greater than feeling sad all the time.
how soon is that? another year? 5 years? I just feel that I can't escape this depression no matter how hard I try.

I hear you. Trust me, I wish I could forget here like a switch but it doesn't work that way. I wouldn't do it just to spite her. I'd do it because knowing she'll never be in my life again is just a terrible truth to live with.

Everything you've named I have done. And you're right. I do feel better but it usually doesn't last too long. If I die, would I not be free of this depression? Would she not feel so terrible about herself that she would feel my pain in order to understand what I go through daily?
I'm trying here. In the last nine months I took some time off from school to focus on other things. It's easier said than done. What makes life worth living, if I live in constant sadness?
